# REPLAY-3: Everything the EKF reads at run time comes through the DAL

- Sensor data, per-instance sensor properties, vehicle flags and any value vehicle code sets that changes the EKF's behaviour reach it through the DAL, or Replay diverges from the flight. Compile-time constants and parameters need not, but a parameter cached into a member the EKF reads does.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the AP_NavEKF3 playbook, under [Data Abstraction Layer (DAL) and EKF Replay](../claude/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/CLAUDE.md#data-abstraction-layer-dal-and-ekf-replay). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
